messages.author: 96b171d2e941ddba
messages.subject: problem with facet_wrap
parts:
Dear list,

I have the following code:

ncolsm = 3
title="MyTitle"
colours <- c(AS = "red", RF = "brown", AF =383, PH="cyan",PF = "black",
BA = "green", FI = "blue", FF = 56, PS = "magenta", TC=94)
shapes <- c(AS = "A", RF = "R", AF = "f", PH="H", PF = "P",
BA = "B", FI = "I", FF = "F", PS = "S", TC="T")
pp = qplot(as.numeric(PredTime), as.numeric(dt), data=dss, color=MsgType,
main=title, ylab="Error (min)", shape=MsgType,
alpha=I(1/2), xlim=c(0,60),
xlab="Time before ON (min)", ylim=c(-40, 40)) +
scale_size(to=c(2., 2.), legend=FALSE) +
scale_colour_manual(value = colours) +
scale_shape_manual(value=shapes)

pp2 = pp + facet_wrap(~ msgType, ncol=ncolsm)

pp plots properly.
But pp2 gives:
> pp2
Error in `[.data.frame`(plot$data, , setdiff(cond, names(df)), drop =
FALSE) :
undefined columns selected
> unique(dss$MsgType)
[1] AS PF RF AF BA FI FF TC PS PH
Levels: PH < PS < AS < BA < PF < RF < AF < FI < FF < TC

How does one go about debugging such an error?

Thanks,
Jim Rome

messages.subject: Re: problem with facet_wrap

"undefined columns selected" is a pretty clear error message. The
question is why.

names(dss) shows that you have a variable named MsgType, but no
variable names msgType.

Best,

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: problem with facet_wrap
parts:
On 6/30/2011 1:16 PM, James Rome wrote:
> Dear list,
>
> I have the following code:
>
> ncolsm = 3
> title="MyTitle"
> colours<- c(AS = "red", RF = "brown", AF =383, PH="cyan",PF = "black",
> BA = "green", FI = "blue", FF = 56, PS = "magenta", TC=94)
> shapes<- c(AS = "A", RF = "R", AF = "f", PH="H", PF = "P",
> BA = "B", FI = "I", FF = "F", PS = "S", TC="T")
> pp = qplot(as.numeric(PredTime), as.numeric(dt), data=dss, color=MsgType,
> main=title, ylab="Error (min)", shape=MsgType,
> alpha=I(1/2), xlim=c(0,60),
> xlab="Time before ON (min)", ylim=c(-40, 40)) +
> scale_size(to=c(2., 2.), legend=FALSE) +
> scale_colour_manual(value = colours) +
> scale_shape_manual(value=shapes)
>
> pp2 = pp + facet_wrap(~ msgType, ncol=ncolsm)
>
> pp plots properly.
> But pp2 gives:
>> pp2
> Error in `[.data.frame`(plot$data, , setdiff(cond, names(df)), drop =
> FALSE) :
> undefined columns selected
>> unique(dss$MsgType)
> [1] AS PF RF AF BA FI FF TC PS PH
> Levels: PH< PS< AS< BA< PF< RF< AF< FI< FF< TC
>
> How does one go about debugging such an error?

The error hints that a column in the data was requested that doesn't
exist. (OK, hint may be too strong. That construct is from using
subsetting on a dataframe with column names, and the error is what you
get if you specify a column name that doesn't exist.)

So looking at your code to make sure all the columns (variables) you
request are there, and knowing that the difference is between pp and
pp2, I notice that the only additional variable (from the data) in pp2
is msgType. I also notice that in the previous plot, there is variable
MsgType (note initial capital). Checking the data you attached, there
is only a MsgType, no msgType. So it should be:

pp2 <- pp + facet_wrap(~ MsgType, ncol=ncolsm)

Yes, a long way to say you made a typo. But you asked how to go about
debugging such an error.

> Thanks,
> Jim Rome
>
